summary: Guangling District is one of the three districts of Yangzhou in Jiangsu province, China. It covers the eastern half of Yangzhou's main urban area, including the historic center within the former city wall, plus the city's eastern suburbs. The other half of the main urban area lies in Hanjiang District.
one_line: Guangling District is an eastern urban and suburban district of Yangzhou, Jiangsu, China, containing the city's historic center within the former city wall.
